home_title.en: Virtual DOM JavaScript Framework with Data Binding | QuickUI
home_title.zh: JavaScript 前端框架：資料綁定與 i18n｜QuickUI

en.home: QuickUI is a vanilla JavaScript framework with virtual DOM diffing, data binding in plain HTML templates and runtime i18n, by 邱敬幃 Pardn Chiu (pardnchiu).
en.getting-started: Install QuickUI from CDN, npm or ESM, build it from source, and bind your first data object to an HTML template.
en.architecture: How QuickUI layers its entry class, virtual DOM, lifecycle, utilities and listeners, and how it compares with similar JavaScript libraries.
en.rendering-pipeline: Each step of a QuickUI render: directive expansion, text replacement, index-based diffing and the six patch types.
en.reactive-data: How the Proxy around app.data detects changes, which writes trigger a re-render, and when the data becomes available.
en.text-binding: Write data into text with {{ value }} placeholders and insert raw HTML with the :html directive.
en.built-in-functions: LENGTH, CALC, UPPER, LOWER and DATE inside {{ }}: syntax, supported operators and date tokens.
en.conditional-rendering: Show elements with :if, :else-if and :else, the comparison operators, special values and evaluation rules.
en.loop-rendering: Repeat elements over arrays and objects with :for, including index variables, loop scope and nested loops.
en.attribute-binding: Bind data to HTML attributes with the : and q- prefixes, how values are dispatched, and how :hide decides.
en.style-binding: Bind data to inline styles with :[CSS property] and replace the legacy :bg-* and camelCase names.
en.event-binding: Wire native DOM events to handlers with @event or qe-, handler lookup rules, and getting loop items.
en.two-way-binding: How :model writes input, textarea, select, checkbox and radio values back into data.
en.i18n: Define locales as objects or JSON files, reference translations in text and attributes, and switch with app.lang().
en.lifecycle: When beforeRender, rendered, beforeUpdate and updated fire, their arguments, and how returning false cancels a render.
en.block-insertion: Load an external HTML file into a QuickUI template with the temp element and :path, including load order and failure cases.
en.lazyload: Load images only when they enter the viewport with :lazyload, the loading placeholder and the 404 fallback.
en.svg-inline: Replace a temp-svg element with the inline SVG markup of an external file so CSS can style it, and what is carried over.
en.effects: Fade-in, expand and skeleton mask effects on the root element during the first QuickUI render.
en.constructor-options: Every new QUI() option with its type and default, how id and render combine, and option interactions.
en.instance-api: Methods and properties on a QUI instance: lang(), fragment(), data, event, body and isScheduled.
en.render-shorthand: The tag#id.class(attr)[children] shorthand returned by render, whitespace handling and supported directives.
en.global-helpers: The global $ element lookup and _ element builder that QuickUI registers on window, with argument rules.
en.deprecations: QuickUI syntax planned for removal in 1.0.0: lifecycle object, snake_case hooks, legacy style names and animation.

zh.home: QuickUI 是邱敬幃 Pardn Chiu（pardnchiu）開發的 JavaScript 前端框架：虛擬 DOM 差異更新、HTML 模板資料綁定與執行期 i18n，免建置。
zh.getting-started: 以 CDN、npm 或 ESM 安裝 QuickUI，從原始碼建置，並把第一個資料物件綁定到 HTML 模板。
zh.architecture: QuickUI 的入口類別、虛擬 DOM、生命週期、工具函式與監聽器如何分層，以及與同類 JavaScript 函式庫的關係。
zh.rendering-pipeline: QuickUI 每次渲染的步驟：指令展開、文字替換、依索引比對，以及六種 Patch 的套用順序。
zh.reactive-data: app.data 的 Proxy 如何偵測變更、哪些寫法會觸發重新渲染，以及資料何時可以存取。
zh.text-binding: 以 {{ value }} 把資料寫入文字，並以 :html 指令插入原始 HTML。
zh.built-in-functions: {{ }} 中的 LENGTH、CALC、UPPER、LOWER、DATE：語法、可用運算子與日期代碼。
zh.conditional-rendering: 以 :if、:else-if、:else 控制顯示，含比較運算子、特殊比較值與判斷規則。
zh.loop-rendering: 以 :for 依陣列或物件重複元素，含索引變數、迴圈作用域與巢狀迴圈。
zh.attribute-binding: 以 : 與 q- 前綴把資料綁到 HTML 屬性、各屬性的寫入方式，以及 :hide 的判斷規則。
zh.style-binding: 以 :[CSS 屬性] 把資料綁到行內樣式，以及舊式 :bg-* 與 camelCase 名稱的替代寫法。
zh.event-binding: 以 @event 或 qe- 把原生 DOM 事件接到處理函式，含名稱查找規則與在迴圈中取得項目。
zh.two-way-binding: :model 如何把 input、textarea、select、checkbox、radio 的值寫回資料。
zh.i18n: 以物件或 JSON 檔定義語系，在文字與屬性中引用翻譯，並以 app.lang() 切換語言。
zh.lifecycle: beforeRender、rendered、beforeUpdate、updated 的觸發時機、參數，以及回傳 false 取消渲染。
zh.block-insertion: 以 temp 元素與 :path 把外部 HTML 檔載入 QuickUI 模板，含載入順序與失敗時的行為。
zh.lazyload: 以 :lazyload 在圖片進入視窗時才載入，含載入佔位圖、404 替代圖與停用方式。
zh.svg-inline: 把 temp-svg 元素換成外部 SVG 檔的內嵌標記，讓 CSS 能控制樣式，以及會保留哪些屬性。
zh.effects: QuickUI 初次渲染時根元素的淡入、展開與骨架遮罩效果，以及 mask 的正確寫法。
zh.constructor-options: new QUI() 每個選項的型別與預設值、id 與 render 的組合，以及選項之間的交互作用。
zh.render-shorthand: render 回傳的 tag#id.class(attr)[children] 簡寫格式、空白處理與可用指令。
zh.global-helpers: QuickUI 掛在 window 上的 $ 元素查找與 _ 元素建立工具，以及各參數規則。
zh.deprecations: QuickUI 預計在 1.0.0 移除的寫法：lifecycle 物件、snake_case 鉤子、舊式樣式名稱與 animation。
